title: New England Hydro-Transmission Electric Company, Inc. is an electric Company being organized under Chapter 164 and 156B of the General Laws of Massachusetts. Pursuant to the provisions of General Laws, Chapter 164, Section 6(a)(5), it is requested that the Department authorize and approve the par value of $1 per share for the common stock of New England Hydro-Transmission Electric Company, Inc.
